empirical_percentile: right-side search rank divided by training reference count, clipped to [0,1]
specialist_disagreement: mean over probability, Strong-R and Extreme-R components of the standard deviation across available global/direction/candidate predictions divided by the matching global training-prediction standard deviation; final value clipped to [0,1]
selection_gate: behavior_score >= training-reference quantile for the selected retention fraction AND p_percentile >= selected probability-percentile threshold
dedup_after_gate: highest proposal_strength_label_free then lexical candidate_id at the same decision_time and direction
one_position_after_dedup: separate candidate_id state, next entry allowed only when prior admitted exit_time <= current decision_time
